A B Penal Code, 1860: s.302, s.302 rlw s.3,/,. 364 -Abduction and murder - Previous enmity between victim-deceased and C accused persohs - Allegation that accused persons abducted the victim-deceased and thereafter killed him and threw his body on railway tracks - Since at that time the identity known, the police after investigation buried the body - On complaint of missing of deceased and investigation, the D police exhumed the body and after DNA examination found it to be that. of the victim-deceased - Conviction of accused no. 1 to 3 based on circumstantial evidence - On appeal, held:
